decisions.decision: Use stable storage slots plus a dense draw list for Phase 03 gap closure.
decisions.rationale: This removes sparse-slot indirect draw errors without compacting stable GPU storage or expanding scope into later phases.

decisions.decision: Keep compute semantics minimal and metadata-driven.
decisions.rationale: Phase 03 only needed end-to-end closure through chunk metadata, dense indirect preparation, and graphics placement, not frustum or camera systems.

decisions.decision: Treat the missing VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation bootstrap failure as a Phase 03 gap, not an environment-only note.
decisions.rationale: The failure is encoded in src/renderer/instance.rs and blocks the default debug startup path itself.
